🎉
Today Moscow and Muscovites celebrate
#CityDay
— a holiday that reflects our Motherland’s history, culture, and traditions.
This year, our beloved capital turns
8️⃣
7️⃣
9️⃣
years old.
📜
Moscow was first mentioned in the ancient chronicles circa 1147. The Ipatiev Chronicle describes an invitation from Prince Yury Dolgoruky to his friends and allies, led by Prince Svyatoslav Olegovich of Novgorod-Seversk, to meet in Moscow:
“Come unto me, brother, to Moscow. And Svyatoslav went to him with his son Oleg.”
Over the past centuries, the small fortress and settlement have grown into a
global metropolis and the capital of the great country.
Today, Moscow is Russia’s largest city with a population of over 13 million covering an area of over 2'500 square kilometres. In total, more than 20 million people live in the Moscow agglomeration. It has a major role in the country’s political, cultural, and academic life and is an attraction hub for talents and ideas from across the globe.
✨
Moscow's city day is not only a tribute to history but also a look forward into the future. The capital incorporates old traditions and modern achievements,
preserving its rich heritage while progressing at a dynamic pace.
The Smart City is an exact reflection of our beloved capital — a leader in the digitisation of urban services.
The history of Moscow is a
story of courage, creation, and the unity
of the entire nation. A Hero City, a symbol of resilience and spiritual strength, Moscow is rightly considered the
heart of Russia.
Moscow will host more than a hundred events on September 5 and 6 to celebrate its
8️⃣
7️⃣
9️⃣
th Anniversary.
👉
See more about the celebration events
Happy Birthday, dear Moscow!
🎉
#Moscow879

item.title: 🎙 ️Comment of the Embassy of Russia in Norway to Aftenposten (September 4, 2026) The Director of the Norwegian Intelligence Service, Nils Andreas Stensønes, has made the following
item.description: 🎙 ️Comment of the Embassy of Russia in Norway to Aftenposten (September 4, 2026) ❓ The Director of the Norwegian Intelligence Service, Nils Andreas Stensønes, has made the following statement to Aftenposten: «Russia seeks to weaken our ability and willingness to support Ukraine. They are attempting to do so through influence operations, cyberattacks and physical attacks. The defence industry is now particularly exposed». Could you please give a short comment regarding these statements? 💬 Answer: Until Mr Stensønes and other representatives of Western governments back up their accusations of our country with specific facts, supported by convincing evidence, we see no point in commenting on the baseless claims they regularly make. 👆🏻 We are convinced that their main aim of such statements is to instil fear in their own populations in order to justify the costly militarisation and securitisation of all spheres of society. Published by Aftenposten

🎙
Comment by Ambassador of Russia to Canada Oleg Stepanov regarding the Federal Court of Canada decision in
«B’nai Brith Canada v. Librarian and Archives Canada, 2026 FC»
(
Ottawa, September 4, 2026
)
🇷🇺
The Embassy welcomes the decision of the Federal Court of Canada of September 1, 2026, in the case “
B’nai Brith Canada v. Librarian and Archives Canada, 2026 FC
”.
We stand in solidarity with the efforts of progressive Canadian civil society
, which for many years
has been seeking the disclosure of the remaining materials of
the Deschênes Commission
.
We consider it no less significant that, against the backdrop of the current debate, Canadian media have not forgotten
the case of Yaroslav Hunka
.
This former member of the 14th Grenadier Division of the SS “Galicia” continues to live untroubled on Canadian soil
.
Let us recall that on October 1, 1946, the International Military Tribunal at Nuremberg declared the SS to be a criminal organization. The “Galicia” Division, in particular, bears responsibility for the genocide of the Russian, Jewish, Ukrainian and Polish people.
❗️
Russia has twice sent official requests to the Canadian Side for his extradition and criminal prosecution on charges of genocide.
Even if the Canadian authorities consider Hunka’s transfer to Russia impossible, this does not exhaust the question of responsibility. The principle of
aut dedere aut judicare
– “extradite or prosecute” – is widely applied in international practice
.
☝️
However, the Canadian Side hasn’t confirmed its readiness to launch an investigation into Hunka’s actions within SS “Galicia” Division.
This situation draws a clear parallel to the cases of two Nazi henchmen
-
Vladimir Katriuk, who died in 2015, and Helmut Oberlander, who died in 2021
. Proceedings in their cases, despite the objectively established facts of the crimes committed, were prolonged for decades until their deaths from natural causes. Consequently, both individuals
spent their final years
in peace and comfort, avoiding criminal prosecution
.

item.title: ⚡️ In connection with Ukrainian statements aimed at creating direct threats to civil aviation
item.description: ⚡️ In connection with Ukrainian statements aimed at creating direct threats to civil aviation , the competent Russian authorities are in contact with the leadership of the International Civil Aviation Organization ( #ICAO ) in Montreal. An urgent appeal on the matter has been sent to ICAO Secretary General Juan Carlos Salazar . ❗️ The Russian Federation has issued a strong protest over Ukraine’s reckless terrorist actions, which run counter to international law. The NOTAMs issued by the Ukrainian authorities alleging that Russian airspace is unsafe have been categorically rejected . They have no legal force , distort the actual situation and mislead users of Russian airspace . We called on the ICAO Secretary General to condemn the Kiev regime’s unlawful interference in civil aviation and the direct threats it is creating, and to take targeted steps to put an end to these actions by Ukraine. ☝️ The Russian Federation remains firmly committed to ensuring the safety of civil aviation.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 4, a meeting between heads of highest judicial bodies of Russia and India
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇳 On September 4, a meeting between heads of highest judicial bodies of Russia and India Igor Krasnov and Surya Kant was held on the sidelines of the BRICS Chief Justices’ Forum in New Delhi. The sides discussed coordination of efforts on the international stage and reaffirmed the continuity of the course aimed at strengthening previously reached agreements. Igor Krasnov stated that deepening Russian-Indian cooperation based on the principles of special and privileged strategic partnership is underpinned by the warm personal and friendly relations between the leaders of our countries, Vladimir Putin and Narendra Modi . 🤝 During the talks, the previously signed Memorandum of Understanding was highly praised. The Russian side has already prepared and submitted to its partners for consideration a draft Programme for cooperation for the next two years. The document includes a list of mutually beneficial initiatives. #RussiaIndia #DruzhbaDosti

Key points
:
• We are not building walls, nor do we want to cut ourselves off from Europe.
It is Europe that has cut itself off from us.
It apparently believed that our past cooperation mattered so much to Russia that we would come running back and beg:
“All right, forgive us, forget what happened. Let us return – just lift the sanctions”.
That is not going to happen.

NATO and the EU – always need an enemy.
Without an artificially created image of Russia as the enemy,
people would get rid of their governments
in the overwhelming majority of EU and NATO countries.

Friedrich Merz
said
that he would once again make Germany Europe’s leading military power, I was simply stunned.
If this person does not understand what the word “again” means in this context, that is deeply troubling and extremely dangerous for Europe
, which is once again becoming a source of ideas of national and racial superiority.
• Germany has
Goethe-Institut
branches in Moscow, St Petersburg and Novosibirsk.
Of course, they will be closed after
our cultural centre was expelled from Germany
. Otherwise, we would have no self-respect.
• If the legislative prohibition of the Russian language in education, culture, daily life, and the media reflects European values,
then Europe is welcome to revert to Nazism
. The ban on the canonical Ukrainian Orthodox Church likewise aligns with “European values”.
•
The principles on which we, and everyone else, recognised Ukraine’s independence
were thrown on the scrap heap long ago.
Yet the West continues to defend Ukraine as a country supposedly standing up for “European values”. Meanwhile,
the EU has economically shot itself in both the foot and the head
, and in other parts of the body as well, by rejecting Russian energy supplies and
blowing up the Nord Stream pipelines

item.title: 🇷🇺 #Announcement On September 9, President of Russia Vladimir Putin will hold talks at the Kremlin
item.description: #Announcement 🇷🇺 🇻🇳 On September 9, President of Russia Vladimir Putin will hold talks at the Kremlin with General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam To Lam , who will visit Russia on a state visit. The Leaders will discuss the current state and prospects for the further development of the Russia-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. Key topics will include trade and economic cooperation, scientific and educational ties, humanitarian exchanges, as well as cooperation in security and defence. The Sides will also exchange views on current international and regional issues . Following the talks, a package of bilateral documents is expected to be adopted. #RussiaVietnam

item.title: 🎙 Comment by Ambassador of Russia to Canada Oleg Stepanov to The Canadian Press News Agency on recent Prime-Minister Mark Carney's
item.description: 🎙 Comment by Ambassador of Russia to Canada Oleg Stepanov to The Canadian Press News Agency on recent Prime-Minister Mark Carney's remarks ( Ottawa, September 3, 2026 ) ❗️ I am compelled to correct Prime Minister Carney. Russia was, remains and will remain a member of the Group of Twenty. As for the fate of the G8 format, it ceased to exist in 2014. Let me recall how this came about. In 2014, Moscow held the presidency of the group. Following Crimea’s reunification with Russia , the other seven members decided, for political reasons, to withdraw from the G8 format. In other words, they excluded themselves. ☝️ The G8 no longer exists. And that is perhaps for the best. We have no interest in reviving it . In contemporary international affairs, it is new-type formats such as the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation and BRICS , as well as the aforementioned Group of Twenty, that command the greatest authority. The G7, by contrast, has long since become a grouping that exists on paper only, perpetuated merely for its own sake. Whatever prestige it may once have enjoyed no longer carries any weight in contemporary international relations. Such is the reality.
